parts.text:
Many farmers grow banana plants near location Q.

of banana plants.

Describe the process of pollination.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Some banana fruits are exported to Europe and labelled as ‘organic, fair trade bananas’.
Organic banana plants are grown without using chemical fertilisers or pesticides.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State how farmers who grow organic bananas can control pests on their banana plants.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State how farmers who grow organic bananas can ensure the soil has enough nutrients.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: State one negative impact of using chemical fertilisers.

parts.label: (iv)
parts.text:
Fair trade is when companies agree to pay a fair price to farmers for a crop.
Suggest one reason why people in Europe want to buy fair trade bananas.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Bananas are stored in refrigerated containers at 13 °C and loaded onto ships.
It takes 20 days to transport the bananas to Europe by ship.
This transport accounts for 60% of the carbon footprint of banana production.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Define the term carbon footprint.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Suggest why bananas are kept at 13 °C during the journey to Europe.

beaches.
